channel.title: Crypto in Brief
channel.description: Illustrated cryptocurrency explainers with interactive browser labs for readers with no assumed background. Written by Moamen Basel.

item.title: Bitcoin and crypto, an illustrated overview
item.dc:creator: Moamen Basel
item.description: A visual overview of hashing, mining, signatures, transaction models, privacy, consensus, and execution.

item.title: Bitcoin from zero
item.dc:creator: Moamen Basel
item.description: Hashing, blocks, Merkle trees, mining, signatures, forks, finality, and transaction ordering with browser labs.

item.title: Proof of stake from zero
item.dc:creator: Moamen Basel
item.description: Validators, proposer selection, attestations, fork choice, slashing, and economic finality through Ethereum examples and simulations.

item.title: Solana from zero
item.dc:creator: Moamen Basel
item.description: Proof of history, slots, Tower BFT, validator voting, and parallel execution with three interactive labs.

item.title: Sui from zero
item.dc:creator: Moamen Basel
item.description: The object model, owned and shared transactions, Mysticeti consensus, Move types, and zkLogin.

item.title: Monero under the hood
item.dc:creator: Moamen Basel
item.description: Stealth addresses, ring signatures, key images, RingCT, network privacy, and the limits of toy cryptographic models.

item.title: Zcash from zero
item.dc:creator: Moamen Basel
item.description: Shielded notes, nullifiers, viewing keys, optional privacy, and the documented lineage from Israeli and American research to a coin launched by a US company.

item.title: Zero knowledge from zero
item.dc:creator: Moamen Basel
item.description: Interactive proofs, Fiat Shamir, SNARKs, STARKs, selective disclosure, and privacy preserving identity.
